## How It Works

GitHub uses these default files when:
1. A repository doesn't have its own version of a particular file
2. The file is in the root, `.github/`, or `docs/` folder of the repository
3. The `.github` repository is public

## File Precedence

GitHub looks for files in this order:
1. `.github/` folder in the individual repository
2. Root of the individual repository
3. `docs/` folder in the individual repository
4. This `.github` repository (as defaults)

## Customization

Individual repositories can override these defaults by creating their own versions of any file in their `.github/` folder.
